title: Margin scenario lab
question: What margin do we reach next quarter if price, volume and cost move, and how likely is the target?
story: The base case earns {base_p50} next quarter, with a {base_chance} chance of reaching the target.
questions: Which lever moves the margin the most?
How far must price move to reach the target?

datasets.name: model
datasets.sql: SELECT m.driver, m.coefficient FROM main.finance.margin_out__scenario_model AS m

datasets.name: scenarios
datasets.sql: SELECT s.scenario_id, s.lever_values, s.outcome, s.p10, s.p50, s.p90, s.prob_target, 100 * s.prob_target AS chance_pct FROM main.finance.margin_out__scenarios AS s

datasets.name: sensitivity
datasets.sql: SELECT t.lever, t.low, t.high, t.delta FROM main.finance.margin_out__sensitivity AS t

datasets.name: runs
datasets.sql: SELECT o.as_of_date, o.value, o.region, o.category, o.channel FROM main.finance.margin_out AS o WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

kpis.label: Base case margin
kpis.expression: MAX(CASE WHEN scenario_id = 'base' THEN p50 END)

kpis.label: Chance of the target
kpis.expression: MAX(CASE WHEN scenario_id = 'base' THEN chance_pct END)

charts.title: What moves the margin
charts.hint: Margin at the low and the high end of each lever, from the base case.
charts.so_what: Work the widest bar first: it moves the margin the most.

tables.title: Scenarios
tables.hint: Base, upside and downside cases with their range.
tables.so_what: Plan on the P50 of the scenario you choose and hold a buffer for the P10.

scenario.title: Move the levers
scenario.hint: Each lever moves within 10% of its base case value.
